span.p:
Tier 1: File Paths & Storage
local drives (C:, D:, ~/, /home/),
env vars (%appdata%, %USERPROFILE%),
sensitive folders (documents, system32, .ssh)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 2: System & Destructive Commands
shell commands (cmd, regedit, rm -rf, format)
word-boundary matching to prevent false positives

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 3: Personally Identifiable Information (PII)
SSN pattern, credit card + Luhn validation,
RFC 5322 emails, phone numbers,
keywords ('my password', 'social security')

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Tier 4: Token/Credential Patterns
JWTs (eyJ... header), API key formats,
Bearer token prefix detection
